fullContentHtml:
The NDA Result 2026 has been released on 08th May 2026 by UPSC for the NDA 1 exam that was held on 12th April 2026. Now, candidates can check the NDA 2026 result PDF, which is made available on the official website, to know if they qualify or not. In the NDA result, the list of selected candidates is included. These roll numbers will participate in the SSB Interview. The NDA 2 Exam 2026 will be conducted on 13th September 2026. The selected candidates for the NDA exam will have to undergo the SSB Interview process, which will be organized between June and August 2026.

Is Nda 2026 Result Out? Latest Updates

Yes, the result for NDA 2026 is out! The UPSC has uploaded the result in PDF form on its official website. There are no score cards issued to individuals at this point in time. Only the roll numbers of the selected candidates have been released.

NDA 1 Result Date 2026

NDA Result 2026 has officially been announced on 08th May, 2026. Those candidates who had appeared and given the NDA 1 Exam can now verify their eligibility status through the PDF. The result PDF comprises the roll numbers of those candidates who have been selected for further proceedings in the SSB Interview process.

Event Date
NDA 1 2026 Exam Date 12th April 2026
NDA 1 2026 Result Date 08th May 2026
NDA 2 Exam Date 13th September 2026
NDA 2 Result Date October 2026 (Expected)

NDA Result PDF 2026 Download Link

The NDA 1 Result 2026 can be obtained in PDF format from the official UPSC website, upsc.gov.in. Students are required to download the PDF and check their roll numbers to verify their selection for further selection round (SSB Interview). The NDA result PDF 2026 is an official list that indicates whether candidates qualify for the SSB Interview round.

NDA 1 2026 Result PDF: Click Here to Download

How to Check NDA Result 2026 Step-by-Step

Candidates can easily check their NDA result online by following simple steps. Make sure to have a stable internet connection while downloading the result.

╰┈➤Step 1: Visit the official UPSC website, upsc.gov.in

╰┈➤Step 2: Click on the “written results” option from the left sidebar

╰┈➤Step 3: Click on the NDA Result 2026 PDF link

╰┈➤Step 4: Open the result PDF

╰┈➤Step 5: Press Ctrl + F and enter your roll number

╰┈➤Step 6: Check your qualification status

╰┈➤Step 7: Download and save the PDF

Note: UPSC can also provide the NDA 1 2026 result PDF in the latest updates section. Thus, candidates are advised to check the website properly to get the result.

How to Open NDA Result PDF Easily?

Checking the NDA result is very simple because it is provided as a PDF. Candidates can access it if proper tools are used. Make sure your device supports PDF viewing formats like Chrome or Adobe Reader.

  • Use a stable internet connection
  • Download the PDF completely
  • Open using a browser or PDF reader
  • Use the search function (Ctrl + F) for quick access

NDA Result 2026 Download PDF Direct Link

The NDA Result 2026 is available at the official website of UPSC. You can get the link for the same from the “What’s New” or “Examination” tab on the site. It is always advisable to visit the official site in order to avoid any wrong information. Click on the link below to visit the official website.

UPSC NDA 1 Result 2026 Official Website Direct Link

NDA Result Cut Off 2026 (Expected)

Every year, the cut-off scores for the NDA entrance examination differ depending on the difficulty level of the test paper and the number of applicants. The estimated cut-off score helps in knowing the minimum qualifying scores.

Stage Expected Cut Off
Written Exam 300–350 marks
Final Cut Off 680–720 marks

What is the NDA 1 SSB Interview Round Date?

SSB interview dates for NDA 1 have not been declared yet. These interviews will be held after the NDA 1 Result 2026, which is announced on 08 May 2026. As per the general trend, SSB interviews are expected to be held from June to August 2026. The interview dates will vary for candidates as per their roll numbers.

Is 325 a Good Score in NDA 2026?

If a candidate has scored 325 marks in the NDA test, it can be said as a decent number. The candidates within the estimated range of cut-offs have good chances to get selected for the SSB Interview round. Nevertheless, selection will depend on a lot more factors than just marks. Thus, do not get discouraged if the score is 325 or less than this.

NDA 1 Score Card 2026 Release Date

The NDA 1 Score Card 2026 will be declared by UPSC once the whole selection process ends, i.e., after the SSB Interview and merit list. The scorecard will be declared after a few days from the declaration of the final result. The candidates can get their scores for the written test and SSB interview from the official website of UPSC.

NDA 1 Merit List 2026

The final merit list for NDA 1 2026 will be declared after all the processes of the SSB interview and medical tests are over. The names of those candidates who have been selected for the Army, Navy, and Air Force wings will be included in the merit list. For now, only the list of shortlisted candidates is shared as the NDA 1 result.

NDA 2 Notification 2026 Release Date

NDA 2 Notification 2026 will be released on 20th May 2026 through upsc.gov.in. In the notification, you will get information about important aspects, including eligibility, exam dates, how to apply, etc. If you want to appear for the NDA 2 examination, then you must read the notification thoroughly and make your application accordingly.

NDA 2 2026 Exam Date

The date of the NDA 2 Exam 2026 is fixed on 13th September 2026. This examination is being organised by UPSC through an offline test procedure throughout India. It is necessary for candidates to cover their entire NDA syllabus and conduct UPSC NDA mock tests before appearing for the exam.

NDA 1 Result 2026 Related Queries

Q1. When was the NDA 1 Result 2026 released?

Ans: NDA 1 Result 2026 was declared on 08 May 2026. The result was made available soon after the test, and shortlisted candidates can move ahead in the selection process.

Q2. How do I download the NDA 1 Result 2026?

Ans: The NDA 1 Result 2026 is available on the official UPSC website. Students should check the PDF format result at the website upsc.gov.in.

Q3. Do I need any login ID/Password to download the NDA 1 2026 Result?

Ans: No, students don’t need any login ID to check the NDA 1 Result 2026.

Q4. Will UPSC send the NDA result through mail/SMS?

Ans: No, UPSC will not send any type of result via email or SMS. The candidates need to check their results on the official UPSC website itself.

Q5. Is there a process to contest the NDA result 2026?

Ans: No, UPSC does not give any scope for challenging or reviewing the NDA result. The result once declared stands final for shortlisting the candidates for the further rounds.

Q6. What if my roll number is not on the list of the NDA result?

Ans: This is a clear indication that you did not qualify for the exam. You need to analyze your performance and focus on your weak areas.
